wiki.title: Jeffrey Hulum III
wiki.extract: Jeffrey Hulum III (born July 23, 1976) is an American politician who is currently serving in the Mississippi House of Representatives from Mississippi's 119th House of Representatives district, a district based in the city of Gulfport in Harrison County. He was elected in a 2022 special election. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Hulum is the Democratic nominee for Mississippi's 4th congressional district in 2026.
